boundedSemantics.fourExactRuntimeTexts: Only cardEffect adopts explicit unchanged current official errata; all other row fields are retained. Registry was already defend-only, so old display text is not proof of an actual standby-play trigger.
boundedSemantics.zeroCount: 715.4 explicitly uses Teemo with zero Hidden: no Deal action exists, so the numeric bonus does not create one.
boundedSemantics.oneCount: One performed Deal of1 to the chosen enemy on Void Gate becomes2.
boundedSemantics.twoCount: Combined interpretation of135.2.b.5.a (one counted Deal instruction) and715 (bonus to the action total), preserving the preexisting single-action aggregation; observed2+1=3. This is a derived bounded expectation, not a quoted official numeric example or certification of every repetition/replacement interaction.
boundedSemantics.order: Original mandatory enemy choice precedes reveal. Original base count remains the reveal payload; local bonus applies only to a performed action before existing prevention and recycling.

exclusions: Whole printings or all possible top-five counts are not certified; bounded execution is counts0/1/2.
All other source departure, reentry, copied or granted trigger and target movement branches retain separate scope.
Global controller bonus on a single counted defense has the separate confirmed Annie#83 counterexample; no global fix is claimed.
Rabadon armament positive bonus, prevention/replacement/resistance and all other damage consumers remain separately open; adjacent passing tests do not certify their complete semantics.
Current new fixed full, visible paired native controls/reconnect/normal scoring/full replay and physical Windows remain open.
All source gaps, original dates,143 original full-game methods,110 pairs,11 decks,seed424242 and assertions are retained.
